ModMetaData.name: Spa & Sauna
ModMetaData.author: johnbrimstone
ModMetaData.description: Adds buildable spa/sauna facilities with mood-boosting effects. Sauna is a room role (like Bedroom or Hospital) scored by heater + seating furniture; heater variant determines the buff archetype (Detoxified, Purified, Serenity, and more). v1 is standalone; a soft-dependency Hospitality integration (guest billing, staff role) is planned for a later release.
